name: Divine Lines Tattoo
niche: tattoo studio (custom, floral, black and grey, color, fine line)
address: 7645 Merrill Rd Unit 103, Jacksonville, FL 32277, United States
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile's website field points only to Instagram (@DivineLinesJax), which does not count as an own domain per pipeline rules. WebSearch for the business name plus 'email contact booking' found only directory/listing sites (tattooswizard.com, wanderlog) and generic third-party tattoo-studio booking form templates (jotform.com links unrelated to this shop), no owned domain.
email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (phone only), WebSearch for the business name plus contact/booking terms, and the verified Instagram handle @DivineLinesJax (bio not independently fetchable from this session). Phone is the only confirmed public contact channel; outreach registered as pending_manual.

services.source: Derived from verbatim Google reviews naming specific artists and styles, the business's own Google photos (black and grey floral, color/portrait, fine line, small pieces), and a real price point ('Starting at just $50') visible as text baked into one of the business's own promotional Google photos.
services.pricing_note: One real promotional price point found directly in a first-party Google photo ('Open From 12-9pm. Starting at just $50.'), used as real data in the services section copy. No full price list found, so the adapted variant still applies for anything beyond that one data point: call for a quote.

reviews_verbatim.name: Sarah Pettit
reviews_verbatim.text: I love this shop, all of the artists are so talented and nice! They are always willing to work with you to make sure you get exactly what you are looking for out of your tattoo!! I have gotten many pieces by many artists and will continue to get my tattoos here!

reviews_verbatim.name: Leandria
reviews_verbatim.text: Had a simple idea for an hand/forearm tattoo and booked with Zo. I came out with a masterpiece on my skin! Zotatsyu has great communication and shared his vision with me on the tattoo I wanted and made it better than I could have imagined...

reviews_verbatim.name: O'Connor Farms
reviews_verbatim.text: I adore this shop and the artists there feel like family. The art is stellar, not a single slack artist in the building...

reviews_note: 3 real verbatim Google reviews (2 truncated at Google's own preview length) out of 494 total, collected via scripts/maps_research.py. Named artists Zo/Zotatsyu, Andy and Ryan confirmed directly from reviews.

Gallery: black and grey floral sleeve with butterflies on an upper arm.
Gallery: black and grey floral thigh piece with dotwork mandala accents.
Gallery: fine line dragon tattoo on a forearm.
Gallery: small skeleton-hand-and-flower tattoo behind the ear, shows range beyond large pieces.
Gallery + contact section: detailed portrait tattoo of a woman with ram horns and florals.
About section + avatar: real photo of the shop's front counter with its 'Welcome to Divine Lines Jax' sign.
About section: artist wiping down a fresh floral/moth leg piece mid-session, real work-in-progress shot.

gallery_excluded.reason: Script/handwriting forearm tattoo, decent but redundant with stronger floral/color pieces already selected; kept the set to the 5 strongest distinct styles.

Has a baked-in text overlay ('Open From 12-9pm. Starting at just $50.'); PIPELINE.md Fase 3 prohibits text-overlay captions in gallery tiles, but the real price text was still extracted and used in the services section copy.

hours_note: The business's own Google photo (excluded from gallery for its text overlay) reads 'Open From 12-9pm'; a third-party directory separately lists 11 AM to 9 PM. Used the first-party photo's hours as the more reliable source where referenced, but full hours table omitted from the site since the two sources conflict slightly and could not be cross-verified.
build_notes: Sin precios completos publicados (un solo dato real de precio usado en copy, resto se cotiza); direccion de Google Business usada como ubicacion real del local (es un estudio fisico, a diferencia de los negocios moviles de hoy).
